body:
Hey everyone, we've got a couple nice updates for you today!

👻Chase the Skies Update - 1.21.7

  • The server is now live with 1.21.7, the Chase the Skies game drop! This drop primarily includes the Happy Ghast, a new tame Ghast variant that you can fly around with friends. See here for more info.

  • We've made Happy Ghasts meaningfully faster than in vanilla. Note that Dried Ghasts can be crafted with 8 Ghast Tears and Soul Sand.

  • Saddles are now craftable, so we no longer buy them in the Server Shop.

  • The two new music discs work with Walkman leggings.

  • We currently have the locator bar enabled. Let us know what you think of it.

🗺️Live Server Map

  • At long last, we've launched an SSS live map! It can be found at https://map.sssminecraft.com/. A quick overview of the features:

  • There are maps for spawn, the three survival worlds, and the creative world, which you can swap between in the sidebar.

  • You can see who's online in the sidebar, and the map live updates with player positions and world changes.

  • Hovering shows coords in the bottom left, and the controls in the top-left can toggle visibility of players, world borders, and the world spawn.

📝Other Updates

  • Aphelion of Earth's tendril attacks and Abomination are now treated as magic attacks, letting them synergize with Impetus of Hecate.

  • Vanilla rendering updates allow glows to work with shaders, which importantly means you can see ores sensed with Abyssal Armor with shaders on!

  • When Transmuting to clay, you now get clay balls instead of clay blocks.

Thanks friends 🫶
